fusions.name: Unheard Descent
fusions.desc: Glides up to 7 tiles onto the target and strikes for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrill Ping
fusions.desc: A shrill call in a cone 5 tiles long deals 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 20% chance of [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hushed Wings
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Nocturne Hunter
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 10% more damage.
